snippet.title: Age of Explorers (By van A&E Television Networks Mobile) iOS / Android Gameplay Video
snippet.description:
Set sail for new worlds! Age of Explorers takes you back to the time when daring sailors took to the seas to discover new lands and map the globe, facing unbelievable challenges and perils.

Age of Explorers is part of Planet H -- a new brand from HISTORY, created for kids to explore historical topics and eras through play.

Experience this exciting era in world history and learn about these brave explorers and the incredible journeys that shaped today's world. Unlock "Did You Know?" facts and learn about the most influential explorers the world has ever known.

Start with Christopher Columbus on his voyage to the Americas, then unlock your way through other famous explorers like Vasco Da Gama, Ferdinand Magellan, Sir Francis Drake and Henry Hudson. Help manage their crew, learn about the challenges they faced and all that they accomplished against impossible odds.

Discover the secrets of history as you set sail on the adventure of a lifetime!

Special Game Features Include:
- Play along with 5 of the most influential Explorers in History.
- Command your crew and keep your ship sailing along world famous routes.
- Battle fires, rats, floods and illness on your ships!
- Learn about their greatest achievements and amazing adventures.
- Collect D.Y.K. facts across this and all other Planet H games.
- One-touch controls keeps you focused on the action.
- 45 levels of fast paced excitement aboard 5 unique ships.
- Colorful animations and voice over keeps history fun, bright, and alive!

App Store - https://itunes.apple.com/nl/app/age-explorers-planet-h-game/id966372391?mt=8&ign-mpt=uo%3D6
